text_block_list.name: Creek & Inari
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: —Ooooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Who will make their move!? Who will 
conquer this 'dream' race!?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(――I really am the luckiest girl in the 
world...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Because I have so many... wonderful 
rivals by my side!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...That was a great race. It truly lets 
you 'dream', don't it? Right, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo & City
text_block_list.text:
"I want to, one more time— I want to, one 
more time—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah... Jeez, seriously—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ――This is the best!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I'm fired up, fired up, fired up!! A 
better race than today! Even greater 
heights than today! That's what I'm aiming 
for!!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"So that I can have the greatest race with 
everyone who's the greatest, once again!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So this is where I make my fresh start, 
tooooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh— Being happier than the winner himself 
takes real guts! That's just like you, 
Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because Bamboo-san is like 
that that I feel I must learn from her...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Watching Bamboo-chan really warms my heart 
from within~. Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Let us compete again next time. I, too, 
shall aim for it. For an even greater 
brilliance, and what lies beyond.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“—I want to run again. In a race like 
this, once more.”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. Making them think so is precisely—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
She is the Umamusume who gives people 
“dreams,” Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Infinitely! Over and over again! Blaze 
on!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Bamboooo!! Memoryyyy!!
